## VERSION INFO
Workflow: DigiTax | Invoice Phase 1 | Shared | Assemble ActivityExecution | v1.0.0
Status: demo-ready (active/published -- required for Execute Workflow to invoke it; no webhook, never externally reachable)
Boundary: normalized outcome envelope (from a Flow 1a branch node) -> one
schema-valid ActivityExecution object (P2.1 activity-execution.schema.json v1.0.0),
never persisted here.
Fail-closed: throws ACTIVITY_BINDING_NOT_PUBLISHED while the embedded binding
literals are null/placeholder, or ACTIVITY_EXECUTION_SCHEMA_INVALID if the
assembled object fails the generated AJV validator.
Called by: Upload Demo, Batch Item, Structured Regression (all Flow 1a).
